sentences: So, given the confidence, we think at least a 10% growth in H2 should be possible in domestic sales.

verdicts.delivered: So far: H1 FY27 revenue growth +30.7% vs ~10% guided for FY27 — on track

bull: Strong H1 FY27 revenue growth of +30.7% YoY to INR 1,05,826 crore.
Highest ever total quarterly sales volume of 696,654 units achieved in Q2 FY27.
Domestic market share increased to 40.8% in Q2 FY27 with 30% festive retail growth.
bear: Q2 FY27 PAT fell 26.4% YoY to INR 2,466 crore alongside margin compression.
EBITDA margin compressed from 12.0% in Q2 FY26 to 8.9% in Q2 FY27.
West Asia conflict-linked commodity increases impacted operating profit in Q2 FY27.
